thread:
alex: seeing a burst of DCGM ECC/Xid alerts in eu-west-1 over the last hour, flood of noise from a few nodes.
chen: yup noticed it too, dozens of dup alerts for same host/card.
alex: current Prom rule is basically "increase(dcgm_ecc_errors_total[5m]) > 0" — too chatty for ephemeral spikes.
sam: can you paste a sample spike window?
alex: logs:
```
# from prometheus: node01-card1
{__name__="dcgm_ecc_errors_total", instance="node01:9100", card="1"} 0 -> 5 in ~60s
```
chen: those are short-lived, probably a driver retry/firmware glitch. Replacement isn't urgent yet.
morgana: proposal: aggregate by node+card, use a longer window and a small count threshold, and coalesce alerts across MIG instances. e.g. increase(...) > 3 over 15m.
alex: also add an experimental 'flap' label to track recurring cards and rate-limit notifications to oncall (suppress duplicates for 30m).
sam: can we adjust rule to ignore single transient Xid0/ECC increments but still catch real degradations? might need a hysteresis.
chen: suggested rule:
```
# alert if a card accumulates >3 ECC/Xid errors in 15m
- alert: GPUCardPersistentErrors
  expr: |
    (
      increase(dcgm_ecc_errors_total[15m])
      + increase(dcgm_xid_errors_total[15m])
    )
    > 3
  for: 10m
  labels:
    severity: warning
  annotations:
    summary: "GPU card {{ $labels.instance }}/card{{ $labels.card }} persistent errors"
    runbook: "https://redwood.internal/runbooks/gpu/card-persistent-errors"
```
morgana: and add a recording rule to compute a 1h sliding count per hardware-id so we can spot repeat offenders without alert noise.
alex: oncall-bot: create incident suppression rule for alerts matching GPUCardPersistentErrors for 30m for same node.
oncall-bot: acknowledged — will suppress duplicates if flapping > 3 within 30m (experimental).
sam: also recommend a nightly job to scan nodes with >5 flap events in 24h and mark them for scheduled reprovision.
chen: I'll open a PR with the rule + recording rule + runbook edits. want to test in staging first.
alex: thanks. after PR, let's run it for 48h in staging with alertmanager silence to validate signal/false positive rate.
morgana: add metric export to telemetry so cost/impact of drains is visible (how many pods evicted per drain).
sam: noted — adding evictions_count metric to the runbook checklist.
chen: PR link once ready — will ping here. :thumbsup:
